name: branding-linocut-raven-stamp-on-ceramic-plates-and-postage-stamps
title: Rough linocut raven with a flower in a frame, printed blue on plates and as black perforated stamps on a kraft box
whatItIs: A white slide with a chunky black linocut-style raven silhouette with a small white flower inside a rough rectangular frame, the caption 'ravenest ceramic', and two photos: blue-printed marks in the middle of white plates with hand-drawn blue rings, and two cream-and-black stamps with perforated edges on a kraft parcel.
whatItMeans: Handmade and characterful; the rough print texture feels artisan and collectable.
techniques: Draw the mark as a rough linocut print.
Print it in blue on ceramics.
Make it a perforated postage stamp on packaging.

vocabulary.definition: A bold relief-print look with rough edges.
A cobalt blue used on ceramics.
